notes.title: Patch notes 2 + Deluxe Edition Now Available!
notes.content:
Magratheus blesses you, Striver.

Thank you for answering the call and fulfilling your duty once more as the Striver, by ridding the land of Ire of the evil Gahars. We have been working hard to fix commonly raised bugs and issues that our brave Strivers have encountered.

We're happy to push through our second patch for the full game, fixing a range of issues with New Game+ and various bugs.
Read the full patch notes below:

[b][h3]Patch Notes - 29/05/2024:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing players to lose mouse control after exiting certain UI.
[*]Fixed a visual bug where dual handed weapons stay on the Strivers back after unequipping then. 
[*](NG+) Fixed an issue causing the Dare of Hardship to allow enemies to 1-Hit the player. 
[*] (NG+) Fixed an issue where the Dare of Insanity wasn't working correctly. 
[*] (NG+) Added a redundancy to recover save data if corrupted during NG+ (If save data is corrupted you will be reset to previous shrine)
[/list]
Alongside this we are also delighted to announce that we now have a Digital Deluxe edition of the game available which includes an artbook and a full soundtrack!

Find the link to the Digital Deluxe edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41198/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire_Digital_Deluxe_Edition/]here[/url].

If you encounter any other bugs on your journey through Ire, please leave your bug report on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2171560/discussions/0/4331977981785818130/?snr=2_9_100003_]dedicated reporting thread here[/url]. We are monitoring these issues and will continue to fix as many issues as we can.

And please continue to leave your thoughts and feedback in discussions and reviews, we’d love to hear what you think about the game!

notes.title: Fixes to NG+, collision issues, crashes and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you for answering the call and fulfilling your duty once more as the Striver, by ridding the land of Ire of the evil Gahars. We’re so happy to see all the positivity around the game, and have been working hard to fix commonly raised bugs and issues that our brave Strivers have encountered.

We’re happy to push our first patch for the full game, fixing a range of issues with New Game +, collision issues and other bugs. Read the full patch notes below:

[h3][b]Patch Notes - 21/05/2024[/b][/h3]
[b][list]
[*]Fixed some collision issues in Dunghaven. 
[*]Fixed some collision issues in Cinder Valley.
[*]Fixed some collision issues in Irelia.
[*]Adjusted some of the collisions in the final Dunghaven encounter. 
[*]Changed some enemy pathing in Rimehold. 
[*]Adjusted the aggression of some enemies in Rimehold. 
[*]Adjusted the Skull Demon placement in Irelia. 
[*]Reduced the HP of the Snail Queen enemy.
[*]Fixed the crash that would occur when viewing the 'Spectre' entry in the Morbid Menagerie.
[*]Cleaned up the cinematic meshes left behind after killing Acolytes that could be seen when revisiting levels. 
[*]Fixed the Strivers hair model when playing on 'Low' graphics settings.  
[*]Bol should now be more inclined to talk to the player in Dunghaven. 
[*]Minor tweaks to the Lava Giant and Carcass King enemies.
[*]Fixed NG+ Not saving correctly. 
[*]Fixed the Hag not showing up in NG+ if the player already has relics from the previous Cycle. 
[*]Fixed the Mastodon enemies collision issue when using the 1st Raging bull attack. 
[*]Fixed the Player sometimes being able to move whilst in the meditation animation.
[*]Fixed Steam Cloud Saves not downloading correctly.
[/list][/b]
These changes, specific to the Rimehold area, will also be reflected in the game’s Demo.

In addition to these fixes, we are also actively looking at community discussions and reviews to see how we can further balance the game. We’re aware that some enemies currently take too little damage at high posture, as well as riposte being very strong right now. We are looking into the best ways to address this. 

If you encounter any other bugs on your journey through Ire, please leave your bug report on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2171560/discussions/0/4331977981785818130/]dedicated reporting thread here.[/url]  We are monitoring these issues and will continue to fix as many issues as we can.

And please continue to leave your thoughts and feedback in discussions and reviews, we’d love to hear what you think about the game!

Magratheus bless you, Striver.

notes.title: The Music of Morbid: The Lords of Ire
notes.content:
Greetings, Striver!

In the last dev diary, we delved deep into the combat of the game. This month, we will hear about the music. Simo Talasranta, the court composer of Still Running, has written and produced the fully orchestrated original soundtrack of Morbid: The Lords of Ire. Hear from him, how the score of the game has more to it than meets the ear.

Watch the brand new feature video, "The Music of Morbid: The Lords of Ire", where Simo talks about his craft below:

[previewyoutube=_vzquxWI_Lk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/fc10c018df5c11cd7f3ec42bac8db710827e360d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Morbid Motifs[/b][/h3]

The soundtrack of Morbid: The Lords of Ire has been composed using an interconnected network of leit motifs (musical themes). In addition to the Acolytes having their own themes, the game has three main motifs that present themselves in various rhythmic, harmonic, and instrumental combinations throughout your journey.

[h3][b]Musical Journey[/b][/h3]

A good example of the interconnected themes is the music in Hall of Redemption, which not only introduces all three main motifs, but also hides within its melody a phrase from each of the Acolytes’ themes. In other words, the music of the hub area subliminally sets up your entire journey, before you’ve barely embarked on it.

[h3][b]Instrumentation[/b][/h3]

For the most part, the soundtrack utilizes the instrumentation of a traditional symphonic orchestra accompanied by a choir. However, since the game is set across several realms with different cultures, some tracks take a steady step into the domain of fusion music, combining oriental, tribal, and even electric instruments into the mix.

[h3][b]The Acolytes[/b][/h3]

In Morbid games, the epic boss tracks have always been—and are still—the most prominent part of the score. They draw a stark contrast between the haunting desolation of the world, and the sudden piercing terror of the ungodly encounters therein.

Additionally, each Acolyte’s theme is carefully foreshadowed throughout the preceding level, so that once you reach the ruler of the realm, the thematic power of the boss music hits you that much harder.

[h3][b]The Culmination[/b][/h3]

Throughout the game, the three main motifs are prevalent, hidden in almost all the tracks. But only at the very end do they reach their full potential. In the final battle of the game, the three  main motifs collide, playing perfectly on top of eachother, concluding your journey in a fierce storm of the three melodies.


Morbid: The Lords of Ire Original Soundtrack will be released on Spotify and other music platforms together with the game’s release on May 17th 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/fc10c018df5c11cd7f3ec42bac8db710827e360d.png[/img]

If you haven't tried the demo yet be sure to play it now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171560/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire/

Keep up to date on all-things Morbid by checking out our [b][url=https://linktr.ee/morbidthegame]Linktr.ee![/url][/b]

notes.title: Morbid: The Lord of Ire - Next Fest Demo
notes.content:
Greetings, Striver!

Morbid: The Lords of Ire is taking part in Steam's Next Fest!

Take on gruesome foes as you battle across the land of Rimehold in this Demo for Morbid: The Lords of Ire. Cut down horrific enemies and fight to preserve your sanity as you journey to slay the evil Morio, the Man Eater.

You can download and play the Demo now on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171560/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire/

Since we first launched the Demo in December we've been continuously updating the build to bring the best Demo experience to players.

Here's a summary of the key updates to the Demo:
[list]
[*] Improved sprinting feel
[*] Vsync, and controller vibration sliders added in the setting menu
[*] Balanced shroom effects on bosses
[*] Morbid Menagerie improvements and fixes
[*] Morio combat flow improvements on both phases
[*] Lighting quality improved for Rimehold and Hall of Redemption
[*] Thalas now gives Skill Points from completed quests, instead of just XP
[*] New Blessing added at the end of the level
[*] Small projectiles (like arrows) are now deflectable by a well timed block
[*] New unblockable attack effects added
[*] Tons of bugs squashed
[/list]
For Dualshock 4 & 5 users - you can now activate the option to use your PS4 & PS5 controllers work with Morbid: The Lords of Ire on Steam! In the settings menu on the Game Hub page, simply select 'Controller' and set the overide setting for Morbid to 'Enable Steam Input'.

We hope you enjoy the Morbid: The Lords of Ire Demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/c86c9b07944cabbcb4a962808e320304955713aa.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Diary #4 - Blessings
notes.content:
Yuletide Blessings to you, Striver!

We hope that you have all had a festive and merry Yuletide season! As an extra little gift, we're here to bring you a sneak peak into the Blessings feature in [b]Morbid: The Lords of Ire[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/fc10c018df5c11cd7f3ec42bac8db710827e360d.png[/img]

Similarly to Morbid: The Seven Acolytes, the Blessings in [b]Morbid: The Lords of Ire[/b] allows the player to build their character by levelling up and customising the skillset of the Striver in even more varied and tangible ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/ebbd583ce858c228b101db0bd935c0859a5fb327.png[/img]

The Blessings can be found one by one as you progress through the game and find artifacts (Tomes of Insight) which you return to Yan, the Blessed One, in the Hall of Redemption to be deciphered.
Yan also allows you to upgrade tiers and buy more slots for your Blessings using Skill Points. There are maximum of three Blessing Slots, each upgradeable up to level three.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/fc10c018df5c11cd7f3ec42bac8db710827e360d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Blessing of the Healer[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/3b87d817eaea66b3742daf7e0d4788a6a0e5a132.png[/img]
[i]*Blessing Card Concept Art[/i]

Blessing of the Healer gifts the player with a larger Health Bar.
With higher Tiers, it will improve healing effects and give the player another life.

[h3][b]Blessing of the Acrobat[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/19e75ee0e9c31d795063a75777dca3c0446e4f1b.png[/img]
[i]*Blessing Card Concept Art[/i]

Blessing of the Acrobat gifts the player a larger Stamina Bar.
With higher Tiers it regenerates Stamina faster and removes Stamina downtime.

[h3][b]Blessing of the Gunslinger[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/ae4e1199dfc302eb7b45550f46aec54bb55ec19b.png[/img]
[i]*Blessing Card Concept Art[/i]

Blessing of the Gunslinger gifts the player with shots that have more impact.
With higher Tiers the player obtains Piercing Bullets and doubles the Ammo cap.

These 3 Blessings are just some of what you will get to experience in [b]Morbid: The Lords of Ire[/b], and there will be many more unique and useful Blessings to come in the full game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/fc10c018df5c11cd7f3ec42bac8db710827e360d.png[/img]

Don't forget to prepare for your battle against evil by [b]adding Morbid: The Lords of Ire to your Steam Wishlist today[/b].

[h2][b]And play the first Morbid: The Lords of Ire Demo now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171560/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire/

Want to keep up to date on the latest news? Make sure to follow Morbid: The Lords of Ire on [b][url=https://twitter.com/MorbidTheGame]Twitter[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/morbidthegame/]Instagram[/url][/b], or join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/bYCsR2e]Discord[/url][/b] today.

notes.title: Morbid: The Lords of Ire - Teaser
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the newest installment in the Morbid franchise!

[h2][b]Morbid: The Lords of Ire is available to wishlist on Steam now.[/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2171560/Morbid_The_Lords_of_Ire/

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/Bxu9-hzzL_8]Watch the reveal trailer here.[/url][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609920/345a2b63cfeb3c325445033556c6aca03489fa5d.png[/img]

The Seven Acolytes have fallen. Now, [b]The Lords of Ire[/b] awaken.

Return as the [b]Striver[/b] in a new gruesomely 3D souls-like adventure.

Merge Games have teamed up once again with Still Running, the talented development team behind Morbid: The Seven Acolytes, to bring the next installment in the Morbid franchise.

Morbid: The Seven Acolytes is a Horrorpunk Action RPG filled with Lovecraftian horrors and Cronenbergian gore, making it the most gruesome take on the isometric Souls-like genre yet!

In the new sequel, Morbid: The Lords of Ire, players will be able to continue the story of the last surviving Striver of Dibrom in visceral 3D through a blood-soaked world, crafted in the UE4 engine.

[b]Follow and Wishlist Morbid: The Lords of Ire on Steam[/b] to keep up to date with new announcements.
